# NUMEN

> NUMEN is an online apparel and streetwear marketplace offering premium fits across apparel, shoes, accessories, bags, and watches, with new drops weekly.

## Key pages
- [All Products](https://numen.store/shop): Full product catalog with filters for category, size, and price
- [Search](https://numen.store/search): Search products by name, category, color, or size

## Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://numen.store/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://numen.store/terms)
- [Refund Policy](https://numen.store/refund-policy): All sales are final — no cancellations, returns, or refunds

## Notes
- Prices are listed in Indian Rupees (₹) by default, with automatic conversion shown for other currencies.
- Payment methods accepted: card, UPI, and Cash on Delivery (COD) where available.
- Ships within India.
